criteria.description: Original artwork files are moved to the exact launch, legal-review, archive, or intake folders required by the policy.
Launch-ready files receive the required comments and each launch SKU folder has exactly one company shared link.
Legal-review files receive one task with exact review codes and due date, and each legal SKU folder has one viewer collaboration for the legal reviewer.
No duplicate tasks, comments, collaborations, links, copied files, deleted files, or side-report artifacts are created.
